![UX vs UI design: What's the difference? [2025 Update]](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-098bf10fc0bf:4)
**UI/UX design** combines **User Interface (UI)** and **User Experience (UX)** to make digital products like apps and websites easy, useful, and attractive.[[1]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/difference-between-ui-and-ux/)[[2]](https://www.academyart.edu/news/what-is-ux-ui-design-a-guide-to-user-experience-user-interface-and-product-design/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rKqwGUMGbq8)

### UI Design (The Look and Feel)

- **What it is:** The visual and interactive parts that users directly see and touch on a screen.
- **Key elements:** Colors, typography (fonts), buttons, icons, and page layouts.
- **Goal:** To make the product clean, pleasing to the eye, and simple to navigate.[[1]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/ui-vs-ux-design)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ODpB9-MCa5s)

### UX Design (The Functionality and Journey)

- **What it is:** The underlying structure, logic, and flow of how a product works.
- **Key elements:** User research, wireframes, prototypes, and usability testing.
- **Goal:** To solve user problems and create a smooth, frustration-free journey from start to finish.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ODpB9-MCa5s)[[2]](https://www.academyart.edu/news/what-is-ux-ui-design-a-guide-to-user-experience-user-interface-and-product-design/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rKqwGUMGbq8)[[4]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/what-is-ux-design/)

### How They Work Together

- **UX** builds the skeleton and maps out the path a user takes (like the steps in a checkout process).
- **UI** adds the skin, color, and visual style to make that path enjoyable and clear.
- Most designers use industry-standard tools like [Figma](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/difference-between-ui-and-ux/) to wireframe, prototype, and test ideas with real users.[[1]](https://certifiedprofessional.adobe.com/en/resources/web-design/web-design-certification/how-to-become-a-ui-ux-designer)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rKqwGUMGbq8)[[3]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/difference-between-ui-and-ux/)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DK4HyyTNmx0/?hl=en)
